slides.headlineRest: Under Active Attack, Microsoft Patches 398 Flaws
slides.body: Microsoft has issued its latest monthly security updates, addressing a total of 398 vulnerabilities. Notably, one of these patches targets a critical Windows kernel driver flaw that is already being actively exploited in attacks. This zero-day vulnerability allows an attacker with existing code access on a machine to escalate privileges to the highest level, SYSTEM. Users are strongly advised to apply these security updates without delay to secure their systems against this immediate threat.
